circulars.title: Section 42(1) of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 - Change in Daily Minimum Cash Reserve Maintenance Requirement
circulars.summary: Section 42(1) of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 - Change in Daily Minimum Cash Reserve Maintenance Requirement The scheduled banks are allowed to maintain minimum Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) of not less than 90 percent of the required CRR on all days during the reporting fortnight, in such a manner that the average of CRR maintained daily shall not be less than the CRR prescribed by the Reserve Bank. 2. On a review of the current liquidity conditions, it has been decided to increase the minimum daily maintenance of the CRR from 90 per cent of the requirement to 99 per cent effective from the fortnight beginning October 16, 2026.

circulars.title: Liquidity Adjustment Facility - Change in rates
circulars.summary: Liquidity Adjustment Facility - Change in rates As announced in the Monetary Policy Statement dated October 07, 2026 , it has been decided by the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) to increase the policy repo rate under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) by 25 basis points from 5.25 per cent to 5.50 per cent with immediate effect. 2. Consequently, the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate and marginal standing facility (MSF) rate stand adjusted to 5.25 per cent and 5.75 per cent respectively, with immediate effect. 3. All other terms and conditions of the extant LAF Scheme will remain unchanged. Yours sincerely, (G. circulars.title: Standing Liquidity Facility for Primary Dealers
circulars.summary: Standing Liquidity Facility for Primary Dealers As announced in the bi-monthly Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27 , today, it has been decided by the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) to increase the policy repo rate under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) by 25 basis points from 5.25 per cent to 5.50 per cent with immediate effect. 2. Accordingly, the Standing Liquidity Facility provided to Primary Dealers (PDs) (collateralised liquidity support) from the Reserve Bank would be available at the revised repo rate of 5.50 per cent with immediate effect.

circulars.title: Reserve Bank of India (Local Area Banks - Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Amendment Directions, 2026
circulars.addressee: Reserve Bank of India (Local Area Banks - Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Amendment Directions, 2026
circulars.summary: The Reserve Bank had issued the Reserve Bank of India (Local Area Banks – Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Directions, 2025 (hereinafter referred as the ‘Master Direction’), on November 28, 2025, which mandates that any person seeking to make an initial acquisition of major shareholding in a banking company shall obtain prior approval of the Reserve Bank. Further, where such person’s aggregate shareholding, after the initial acquisition of major shareholding, falls below five percent at any point of time, prior approval of the Reserve Bank shall again be required before any subsequent acquisition of major shareholding. circulars.title: Consolidation/ Review of instructions issued on currency management matters – Withdrawal of Circulars/ Guidelines
circulars.addressee: The Chairman / Managing Director / Chief Executive Officer
circulars.summary: All Banks Madam / Dear Sir, Consolidation/ Review of instructions issued on currency management matters – Withdrawal of Circulars/ Guidelines In pursuance of the Reserve Bank’s ongoing initiative to rationalise the regulatory framework, a review of instructions issued on currency management related matters has been undertaken. The exercise involved consolidation of extant circulars/ guidelines into function-wise Master Directions (MDs) and subject-specific instructions. 2. Accordingly, the instructions listed in the Annex , comprising those which have been consolidated into Master Directions, as well as those which have become obsolete or redundant, stands withdrawn.

circulars.summary: All Scheduled Commercial Banks (including Small Finance Banks) Madam/ Dear Sir, Master Circular - Credit facilities to Scheduled Castes (SCs) & Scheduled Tribes (STs) The Reserve Bank of India has, from time to time, issued a number of guidelines/instructions to banks on credit facilities to Scheduled Castes (SCs) & Scheduled Tribes (STs).
